nodes.title: Envoy Edge Gateway Timeout Budget
nodes.content: All synchronous agent tool invocations routed through Envoy must complete within 150ms P99; long-running graph syntheses use async SSE streams.

nodes.title: Multigraph Tenant Isolation Keying
nodes.content: Each organization workspace maps to a dedicated FalkorDB graph key `tenant_{org_id}_memory` inside a shared cluster to guarantee zero cross-tenant traversal leakage.

nodes.title: Model-Agnostic State Handoff Bus
nodes.content: Agents never store state in LLM provider thread memory. Switching an agent between Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini preserves all graph pointers, mounted sub-topics, and traversal paths.

nodes.title: Cross-Region Read Replica Routing
nodes.content: Read-only `inspect_graph_index` queries hit local regional replicas (us-east, eu-central, ap-east), while `update_subtopic_graph` commits route to the primary writer.

nodes.title: Mandatory Pre-Commit PII Redaction
nodes.content: Before any model (Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) executes `update_subtopic_graph`, all node content strings pass through deterministic PII scrubbing.

nodes.title: Ed25519 Ephemeral Agent Leases
nodes.content: Checking out a sensitive sub-topic binds the lease to the Agent ID in FalkorDB rather than a single LLM API key, so hot-swapping models keeps the lease valid.

nodes.title: Cypher Parameterization Enforcement
nodes.content: Raw string interpolation inside agent-generated Cypher mutations is blocked at the driver proxy; all node properties must bind via structured `$params`.

nodes.title: Blocked Unscoped Graph Dump Attempt
nodes.content: On Oct 06, an unconfigured research agent attempted `MATCH (n) RETURN n` across all sub-topics; policy guardrails intercepted and forced summary-only index paging.

nodes.title: Summary-First Context Paging Protocol
nodes.content: Agents hold only the RootGraph directory of SubTopic summaries (~200 tokens total). Full MemoryNode subgraphs are paged into working RAM solely upon explicit `checkout_subtopic` calls.

nodes.title: Immediate Eviction via release_subtopic
nodes.content: As soon as an agent completes reasoning or mutations on a checked-out sub-topic, it invokes `release_subtopic` to drop the full nodes from its prompt window and persist the updated summary.

nodes.title: 800-Token Sub-Topic Split Threshold
nodes.content: When a single SubTopic accumulates more than 800 tokens of MemoryNodes, the coordinator splits it into two distinct sub-topics linked to the RootGraph.

nodes.title: Cross-Model Path & Checkpoint Continuity
nodes.content: Multi-hop traversal paths (:TraversalPath) are persisted as first-class graph citizens. If an agent switches from Claude to ChatGPT mid-task, ChatGPT inherits the exact path and mounted sub-topics.

nodes.title: INC-409: Context Window & Pool Saturation
nodes.content: Prior to hierarchical sub-topic paging, 12 concurrent agents loaded the entire 18,000-token history on every turn, spiking LLM latency to 14.2s and exhausting worker pools.

nodes.title: Playbook: Stale Lease Garbage Collection
nodes.content: If an agent crashes while holding a `HOLDING_CONTEXT` edge on a SubTopic for >5 minutes without heartbeats, the SRE sweeper detaches the lease and restores clean state.

nodes.title: Sub-Topic Paging Cut Token Spend by 84%
nodes.content: Benchmarking after deploying `checkout_subtopic` + `release_subtopic` showed average active prompt context dropped from 1,820 tokens to 290 tokens per agent turn across Claude, GPT-4o, and Gemini.

nodes.title: 2-Hop Cross-Topic Traversal Guard
nodes.content: Automated anomaly triage agents may traverse at most 2 cross-subtopic edges per step without requesting explicit human or coordinator elevation.

nodes.title: Enterprise EU Data Residency Lock
nodes.content: EU Healthcare & FinTech tenants require their FalkorDB multigraph namespace and sub-topic summaries to remain pinned to `eu-central-1` Frankfurt nodes.

nodes.title: $0.004 Maximum Cost Per Agent Turn
nodes.content: Unit economics mandate that multi-agent workflows stay under $0.004 per turn by loading only 1–2 relevant sub-topics at any time instead of full-graph dumps.

nodes.title: Audit Trail Explainability Requirement
nodes.content: Enterprise customers require every agent action to log which LLM model and Agent ID checked out a SubTopic, which MemoryNodes were mutated, and the exact Cypher query.

nodes.title: Multi-Agent Handoff SLA (<2.5s End-to-End)
nodes.content: When Agent A (e.g., on Claude) finishes updating a sub-topic and releases it, Agent B (e.g., on ChatGPT) receives the updated SubTopic summary directory within 120ms.
